answer: In an agent economy, each voting identity must lock a bond, and voting power equals bonded value. Splitting one bond among a thousand bots leaves total influence unchanged. To push a ripple of fake accounts to the zenith of control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize a majority of the voting stake; a comet of fresh identities alone buys no power. Proven double-signing burns the offending bonds, turning detectable cheating into a direct loss.
